anchor_distinction: Contemporary AI systems mostly govern what models may say, access, or call. StegVerse governs whether a proposed transition may become part of system reality.
ai_entity_definition: A bounded, receipt-bearing, consequence-capable work-entity whose authority is externally accredited and revocable.
primary_positioning: StegVerse-001 is a governance/control-plane architecture for consequence-bearing AI transitions, not a direct frontier-model competitor.
core_claim: StegVerse relocates governance to the consequence-binding transition.
claims_to_avoid: StegVerse-001 is smarter than frontier models
A governed packet is installation authority
A receipt alone is production authority

comparison_entities.name: StegVerse-001
comparison_entities.primary_layer: Governance-first work-entity over models, tools, packets, and review surfaces
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Portable receipts, replay lineage, declared-task routing

comparison_entities.name: OpenAI GPT-4o / Responses
comparison_entities.primary_layer: Multimodal model and API tool stack
comparison_entities.control_plane: Model behavior, API policy, account controls
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Logs and platform traces; not native portable consequence receipts
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Strong cognition substrate, not a transition authority layer

comparison_entities.name: Anthropic Claude
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: System cards, logs, retention settings; not portable transition receipts
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Strong assistant lineage, but consequence binding remains external

comparison_entities.name: Google Gemini / Agent Platform
comparison_entities.primary_layer: Model family and enterprise agent platform
comparison_entities.control_plane: Cloud IAM, agent governance, regional/project controls
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Cloud logs and agent traces; not native portable bind receipts
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Strong enterprise agent stack, but authority objects are not the core primitive

comparison_entities.name: Meta Llama ecosystem
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Optional safeguards and observability; no native receipt regime
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Flexible substrate; governance burden shifts to operator

comparison_entities.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
comparison_entities.primary_layer: Enterprise application envelope over LLMs and Microsoft Graph
comparison_entities.control_plane: Tenant permissions, service boundary, admin controls
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Citations, prompts/responses, compliance tooling; not portable transition receipts
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Strong permission grounding, but not transition admissibility

comparison_entities.name: LangGraph
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Tracing and durable execution; receipts must be built by developer
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Strong runtime substrate; authority semantics are external

comparison_entities.name: AutoGPT
comparison_entities.receipt_replay_posture: Platform lifecycle traces; limited intrinsic accreditation semantics
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Continuous automation, but not native consequence admissibility

comparison_entities.name: Waymo Driver
comparison_entities.control_plane: Safety case, operating domain, vehicle/software controls
comparison_entities.production_boundary: Defined service areas and operating conditions
comparison_entities.difference_from_stegverse: Closest on deployment seriousness, but not portable cross-domain transition receipts

done_criteria: Anchor distinction appears in canonical comparison document
Clarified AI entity definition appears before extended comparison language
No public-facing claim implies model superiority, consciousness, sovereignty, or self-accreditation
